description: Public genomic datasets searchable for control populations, reference cohorts, and benchmarking

geo.name: NCBI GEO
geo.description: Largest repository for functional genomics data (RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, methylation, scRNA-seq, etc.)
geo.notes: Use GSE accession to download data via GEOquery R package or GEO2R

sra.name: NCBI SRA
sra.description: Raw sequencing data (FASTQ/BAM) for all NGS data types
sra.notes: Use fasterq-dump for FASTQ download. AWS Open Data mirrors for faster access.

tcga.name: TCGA
tcga.description: Multi-omics cancer data: WGS, WES, RNA-seq, methylation, miRNA, protein, clinical
tcga.notes: Open-access data (somatic variants, RNA-seq) free. Controlled access (germline, raw reads) requires dbGaP approval.
tcga.best_for: Cancer vs normal comparisons; all cancer types

gtex.name: GTEx
gtex.description: Normal tissue gene expression + eQTLs across 54 tissues from non-diseased donors
gtex.best_for: Normal expression reference for any tissue; eQTL analysis

encode.name: ENCODE
encode.description: ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, RNA-seq, RRBS from hundreds of cell lines and tissues
encode.best_for: TF binding, histone marks, chromatin accessibility in cell lines

hca.name: HCA
hca.description: Single-cell transcriptomics atlas of all human cell types
hca.best_for: Normal single-cell reference for any organ/tissue; cell type annotation reference

key_atlases.lung: HCA Lung atlas — 2.4M cells across health and disease
key_atlases.gut: HCA Gut atlas — epithelial, immune, stromal across GI tract
key_atlases.immune: HCA Immune atlas — all blood + lymphoid cell types
key_atlases.brain: HCA Brain atlas — 3M+ cells from all brain regions
key_atlases.heart: HCA Heart atlas — all cardiac cell types
key_atlases.kidney: HCA Kidney atlas — nephron cell types

cellxgene.name: CellxGene Census
cellxgene.description: Unified, queryable collection of 60M+ single cells across all organs
cellxgene.best_for: Largest integrated scRNA-seq reference; query by tissue + disease + organism
cellxgene.notes: Query directly in Python: census = cellxgene_census.open_soma(); no download needed

gnomad.name: gnomAD
gnomad.description: Population allele frequencies: 730,947 exomes + 76,215 genomes from diverse populations
gnomad.best_for: Variant filtering — flag common variants as likely benign; allele frequency lookup
gnomad.notes: GraphQL API available. Also available on GCS: gs://gcp-public-data--gnomad/

dbgap.name: dbGaP
dbgap.description: Controlled-access human genomic + phenotypic data from large studies
dbgap.notes: Requires IRB + dbGaP data access agreement (institution-level). Turnaround ~2-4 weeks.

uk_biobank.name: UK Biobank
uk_biobank.description: 500,000 UK participants: WES, WGS, SNP array, imaging, phenotypes, EHR
uk_biobank.best_for: Largest population genetics resource; phenome-wide association studies

hmp.name: HMP
hmp.description: 16S + WGS microbiome from healthy adults across all body sites
hmp.best_for: Healthy microbiome reference for gut, oral, skin, vaginal, nasal

mgp.name: MGP
mgp.description: Uniformly processed microbiome data from 20,000+ samples across 100+ studies
mgp.best_for: Ready-to-use microbiome data for meta-analysis and control comparison

pride.name: PRIDE
pride.best_for: Proteomics reference datasets; control protein expression

arrayexpress.name: ArrayExpress
arrayexpress.description: Functional genomics data (overlaps with GEO; European mirror + additional datasets)

ccle.name: CCLE
ccle.description: Multi-omics from 1,000+ cancer cell lines: RNA-seq, WES, RPPA, methylation, drug response
ccle.best_for: In vitro cancer model reference; compare patient tumors to cell lines

roadmap_epigenomics.name: Roadmap Epigenomics
roadmap_epigenomics.description: Histone ChIP-seq, DNA methylation, ATAC-seq from 111 reference epigenomes
roadmap_epigenomics.best_for: Reference histone marks and chromatin state maps for healthy tissues

icgc.name: ICGC
icgc.description: WGS + transcriptome from 25,000 cancers across 50+ cancer types (international cohorts)
icgc.best_for: Non-US cancer cohorts; driver mutation analysis

blueprint.name: BLUEPRINT Epigenome
blueprint.description: Methylation + ChIP-seq + RNA-seq from hematopoietic cells

pancan_atlas.name: Tumor microenvironment single-cell pan-cancer atlas
pancan_atlas.description: scRNA-seq from 500+ tumor samples across cancer types
pancan_atlas.best_for: Cancer cell + immune + stromal reference in tumors

immune_atlas.name: Human Immune Cell Atlas
immune_atlas.description: All blood + lymphoid cell types scRNA-seq
immune_atlas.best_for: Immune cell reference for PBMC scRNA-seq
